description: Complete referee response simulation package for ASTRA RASTI paper submission
paper: ASTRA: An Integrated Analysis Framework for Physics-Aware Astrophysical Discovery

C5.title: Turbulence λ/W Characterisation
C5.key_result: λ/W=3.441±0.764; turbulence does not change λ/W (only 5% diff), but accelerates fragmentation 3×

C6.title: Perpendicular-B β-dependence
C6.key_result: β≤0.5: FLAT_PROFILE (no axial fragmentation); β≥1.0: λ/W=1.252±0.092 — 2.75× shorter than longitudinal

C7.title: Critical Transition Mapping
C7.key_result: λ/W=3.382±0.792 (consistent with C5); λ/W increases with B: β=0.3→4.74, β=2.0→2.80; f=1.0 is NOT a stability threshold

C8.title: Field Angle Dependence (θ sweep)
C8.key_result: t_frag(θ≤15°)≈1.3–1.4 t_J (axial beading); t_frag(θ≥30°)≈0.58–0.87 t_J (radial collapse); two regimes

C8_lw.title: λ/W vs Field Angle
C8_lw.key_result: FLAT profile for θ≥45°; measurable λ/W=2.1–2.6 for θ≤30°; λ/W=1.248 at θ=90° β=2.0 only

C10.title: Pairwise vs NN Spacing Bias — HGBS Observational Bias Correction
C10.key_result: Pairwise estimator overestimates by factor 7.0×; NN is unbiased (-0.005×); L/3 pairwise bias confirmed
C10.params: 8 HGBS regions, pairwise vs nearest-neighbour analysis

C13.key_result: Thermal β median=0.057 (mostly below sim range 0.3–2.0); M=2 turbulent-effective β median=0.287 (43% within sim range); sim β=0.3–2.0 physically justified
